# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.

column3: command-line feel
column4: restrained accent (phosphor-amber or soft-green).

column3: prompt
column4: css_template
column5: checklist

column3: Primary button — monospace, bracketed, accent-on-hover
column4: padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--tm-fg); font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--tm-fg); border-radius: 2px; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ hover swaps fg/ground inverse ☐ visible focus ring ☐ 44x44 effective touch via padding

column3: Text-only — mono with caret prefix on hover
column4: padding: 4px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--tm-fg); font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 14px; border: none;
column5: ☐ hover prepends '> ' via ::before ☐ AA contrast ☐ visible focus ring

column3: Page ground — true dark, phosphor warm undertone
column4: background: var(--tm-ground); color: var(--tm-fg); font-family: var(--tm-mono);
column5: ☐ ground L≥0.10 ☐ AA contrast body fg ☐ mono everywhere

column3: Display headline — mono, bracketed, restrained
column4: font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--tm-fg);
column5: ☐ mono throughout ☐ no italic on display ☐ AA contrast ☐ tracking 0 (mono is fixed)

column3: Body — mono, ch-based max-width
column4: font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 72ch; color: var(--tm-fg-body);
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ max 72ch (mono allows wider) ☐ line-height 1.5-1.6

column3: Command prompt — caret + cursor, mono
column4: font-family: var(--tm-mono); color: var(--tm-fg); font-size: 14px;
column5: ☐ aria-label on prompt ☐ blinking cursor respects reduced-motion ☐ AA contrast

column3: Cursor blink — respects reduced-motion
column4: display: inline-block; width: 0.6em; height: 1em; background: var(--tm-fg); animation: blink 1.06s steps(2) infinite;
column5: ☐ @media (prefers-reduced-motion) freezes animation ☐ aria-hidden ☐ AA contrast

column3: Text input — bracketed prompt, mono, transparent
column4: padding: 6px 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--tm-fg); font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--tm-border); border-radius: 2px;
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px iOS via media (or accept 14 with wider hit target) ☐ focus shifts border-color to accent ☐ AA contrast

column3: Data table — mono, ascii-style rules, tabular-nums (mono is)
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ tabular by default (mono) ☐ hairline rules ☐ AA contrast ☐ no chromatic zebra

column3: Feature card — hairline border, mono, square
column4: padding: 16px; background: var(--tm-surface-1); color: var(--tm-fg); font-family: var(--tm-mono); border: 1px solid var(--tm-border); border-radius: 2px;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ hairline border (1px) ☐ no soft chromatic shadow

column3: Top nav — bracketed wordmark, mono links
column4: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--tm-ground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tm-border); font-family: var(--tm-mono);
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link ☐ aria-current ☐ AA contrast

column3: Status badge — bracketed mono
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--tm-success); font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--tm-success); border-radius: 2px;
column5: ☐ semantic colour + text ☐ AA contrast on ground ☐ bracketed feel via tight padding

column3: Log line — mono, timestamp + level + message
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12ch 8ch 1fr; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--tm-fg-body);
column5: ☐ grid uses ch units ☐ tabular by default ☐ AA contrast ☐ semantic <pre> or <li> in list

column3: Section divider — repeating dash pattern
column4: height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--tm-border); margin-block: 32px;
column5: ☐ semantic <hr> ☐ dashed mimics ascii ☐ aria-hidden if decorative

column3: Modal — square bordered, mono, bracketed title
column4: padding: 24px; background: var(--tm-surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--tm-fg); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--tm-mono); max-width: 520px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap ☐ ESC closes ☐ bracketed title pattern ☐ AA contrast

column3: Text selection — accent ground, ground fg
column4: background: var(--tm-fg); color: var(--tm-ground);
column5: ☐ AA contrast inverted ☐ applies via ::selection

column3: Focus ring — fg outline offset
column4: outline: 2px solid var(--tm-fg); outline-offset: 2px;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ AA contrast ☐ offset for visibility

column3: Vertical list — mono, leading dash markers
column4: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--tm-mono); list-style: none;
column5: ☐ semantic <ul>/<li> ☐ ::marker uses '- ' content ☐ AA contrast

column3: Footer — mono, hairline top rule
column4: padding-block: 32px 24px; background: var(--tm-ground); border-top: 1px solid var(--tm-border); font-family: var(--tm-mono); font-size: 13px;
column5: ☐ semantic <footer> ☐ AA contrast ☐ mono everywhere

column3: Hover affordance — inverse swap, no animation
column4: background-color: var(--tm-fg); color: var(--tm-ground); transition: none;
column5: ☐ no soft transition (terminal feels instant) ☐ AA contrast inverted ☐ reduced-motion stable
